blurb: Guests glide through the pristine back waters of South Walton on airboats, exploring the serene landscape and beautiful wildlife of the Choctawhatchee River. Tours include private options for exclusive experiences with just your party. Wildlife sightings include dolphins and alligators, with opportunities for sunset adventures.
